name: WLIQ Prospect Book — anticipated grade, rank and band

what_the_grade_is_for.ruling: PRO-0 (2026-09-04): who we chase first, and how much this is worth pursuing.
explicitly_not: A gate on who we say yes or no to.
A prediction of what the company will be like to work with once they sign.
what_the_grade_is_for.consequence: The instrument outputs a RANK (an anticipated tier plus a chase-order key) and a BAND (PRO-16). It never outputs a single composite number.

architecture.ruling: PRO-17 (2026-09-09): an independent system from the Client Book. Connects at promotion only.
architecture.promotion: PRO-10: an agency with an invoice is an Agency Partner; without one it is a prospect. PRO-18: a person confirms the match at the first invoice; the confirmation, the person and the date are recorded. PRO-9: prospect-era facts cross the seam as a dated prior and never overwrite a first-hand client judgment. The anticipated tier never becomes a client tier.

validation.rule: PRO-8 (pre-registered 2026-09-04): rank agreement (Spearman rho) >= 0.5 on the 31 retrodictable clients, scored as prospects on facts dated before their first invoice. Below 0.5 the grade ships stamped UNVALIDATED and may not be the sole basis for a decision. A grade is never withheld for failing; it is labelled.
validation.measured_so_far: Tier reached vs year-one dollars on the cohort: rho = 0.270, CI [-0.142, 0.647] (PROSPECT_PHASE0 §15). The pre-signing harvest has not run, so PRO-8's literal test is unrun. Every scorecard under this version prints UNVALIDATED.
validation.sizing_pass_mark_note: Owed since PRO-16: a mark on BANDS (does the true year-one land inside the stated band at the stated rate), set against a naive baseline with the transformation disclosed, before the fit is looked at.

vocabulary.tier_ruling: PRO-1r (2026-09-04): same words as clients. Every prospect tier prints the word 'anticipated' and its confidence; prospect rows never sit in a client table without that label. Supersedes the July High / Medium / Low and retires the Tier 1 Opportunity Book's Platinum / Black / Gold.
vocabulary.urgency_note: The July Stage 4 words are kept as the display of a COMPUTED value (research §7). A stated timing fact wins over the computation.

gates.note: July Stage 0, kept as the frame under PRO-15 ('keep the structure, test each piece as data arrives'). The July ledger records the gates AS WRITTEN as never ruled, so each is a toggle with its basis stated. PRO-0: a gate is an operational filter, not what the grade is for — the grade is still computed and stored for a parked row; only the status changes.

service_shape.label: Service shape
service_shape.test: The need is Core or Complement to what WLIQ sells. Off parks.

economics.label: Economic floor
economics.test: Accepts real rates, at or above the floor.
economics.floor_note: Whether the >= $2K floor is about the hourly rate or the deal size is unruled since July (prospect_rulings still_open). deal_size is the default reading; the engine derives economics = fail when deal_size_estimate is stated and below the floor, or hourly_rate_accepted is explicitly false, and never from absence.

broker_character.label: Broker character
broker_character.test: Fair in scoping, negotiation and treatment of expertise.
broker_character.ruling_note: PRO-2r (2026-09-07): character is NOT a grading input. PRO-2r-a is open: does it survive as a safety gate that never scores? Until ruled it is a FLAG only — visible, never scoring, never parking. Switch mode to 'park' if Brian rules the safety valve in.

geography.label: Geography
geography.note: Added by the 9 Sep research brief; no ruling. Off until a territory list exists.

dimension_b.ruling: PRO-2r: 'Is it work we're good at' — service shape, economics, ICP fit. Classifications and facts, zero character judgments.

icp.source: 🧬 ICP Definitions & SQL Classification (2026-04-05, 185 client records). Kept verbatim under PRO-15.

classification_flow.test: agency_type == full_service AND headcount >= 11 AND revenue_band in [5-10M, 10-25M, >25M]
agency_type in [boutique, digital_only, niche_vertical] AND vertical_depth == deep_single_vertical

icp.stated_wins_note: A stated icp_class fact (Notion 'ICP class', or a rater's classification) is used as-is with its evidence label. The flow runs only when no class is stated. If both exist and disagree the stated class stands and the row carries the flag 'ICP disagrees with derivation'.

ICP-6.name: Direct End-Client
ICP-6.ruling: PRO-4 (2026-09-04): in scope, flagged 'Direct-to-client', excluded from agency-only fit weights. The 9 Sep research recommended removal; the ruling stands.

base_tier_from_icp.stated_rule: The July Stage 1 mapping (ICP-1/2/4 → High · ICP-6 → Medium · ICP-3/5 → Low) restated on PRO-1r's four words: High → Gold, Medium → Silver, Low → Bronze. Platinum is never a base; it is EARNED by the platinum_rule below, mirroring the client engine's top-tier gate ('a high-revenue / weak-partner account can't buy Platinum').

adjustments.ruling: July Stage 2, ruled by Brian 2026-07-09: named rules only, every adjustment logged, bumps cap at ONE grade total, ever. The named rules AS WRITTEN were never ruled; each is a toggle with its basis.
adjustments.net_cap_down_basis: reasoned — symmetry with the ruled bump cap; research sizes negatives to matter but a tier ladder has no finer unit than one rung

rules.name: High white-label signal on a boutique or consultant
rules.when: icp_class in [ICP-3, ICP-5] AND wl_signal in [Very High, High]

rules.name: Referral from Brian / AMI / BABA network
rules.source: July Stage 2; research §3: a warm path is one of the strongest inputs

rules.name: Boutique clears the $10K project floor and already outsources
rules.when: icp_class == ICP-3 AND avg_project_size >= 10000 AND already_outsources == true
rules.source: Research §Fit: profitability cliff at $5K; keep ICP-3 only where average project is $10K or more and they already outsource

rules.name: Account management separate from project management
Platform partner badge
rules.source: Research: badges require real managed volume

rules.name: Niche specialist in an unproven vertical
Under 8 people, owner does everything
rules.when: (headcount != null AND headcount < 8) AND owner_does_everything == true

rules.name: Large agency with an in-house dev team
Shrinking agency
rules.source: Research: headcount down, BD turnover, dormant marketing

adjustments.agency_only_note: PRO-4: direct-to-client rows (relationship_type == direct or ICP-6) are excluded from agency-derived rules. ADJ-REF and ADJ-AI still apply to them.

requires_all.reason: Partner ceiling with climb evidence (headroom ≥ $100K band or stated Partner, and at least one climb signal)
the deal is real: at least three of money, authority, timing, specification present

platinum_rule.why: Research tier table: Tier 1 = Fit A or B, ceiling Partner with at least one climb signal. Under PRO-0 the top of the chase order must be both the best fit and the biggest real deal; a Gold that is not yet real ranks below a Gold that is.

confidence.note: Confidence prints beside every anticipated tier (PRO-1r). It is about the INPUTS, not about validation — validation is a separate stamp (PRO-8).

dimension_a.ruling: PRO-2r: 'Is the deal real' — money, authority, timing, specification. Facts a salesperson has or does not have; mostly a CRM read.

money.test: A stated budget, or a quote issued.
money.evidence: PandaDoc or Orbit quote · a budget figure recorded in the CRM

authority.test: Someone who can say yes, and we have met them.
authority.evidence: who attended the calls · who is named on the proposal · who is copied on the quote

timing.evidence: the urgency stamp / a stated timeline

specification.test: They can say what they need in enough detail to quote it.
specification.evidence: the brief · the RFP · the proposal · the quote

dimension_a.min_facts_note: OPEN (prospect_rulings still_open): how many of the four must be present before a prospect can be ranked. Default 0 — the tier is always published with the qualification label beside it, because a skip is a real answer. Raise this to hide tiers on 'Conversation' rows once Brian rules.

specification.note: Approximation flagged at seed: an immediate need is not a written scope. Treated as inferred.

potential.ruling: PRO-16 (2026-09-05): a rough band is enough; the point estimate is dropped. Headroom method from the client-grading-system skill, locked; vendor rank from the Wallet Allocation Rule (research §Potential).

revenue_per_head_usd.basis: locked headroom method; Promethean $163K avg, SPI $168K

potential.serviceable_share_basis: reasoned — the skill derives it from service mapping; until that pack exists half of a blended agency's outsourceable menu is assumed to map to WLIQ's eleven service families

winnable_share.default_basis: reasoned — '#1 of 3'; the two discovery questions (who else do you use, where do we rank) replace it

potential.headroom: wallet * winnable_share - trailing_12m_revenue, where wallet = headcount * revenue_per_head * outsourceable_share * serviceable_share
potential.headroom_bands_basis: research tier table: Tier 1 headroom ≥ $100K, Tier 2 $35K–100K

climb_evidence.rule: The ceiling may not exceed Project without at least one observed climb signal (July Stage 3; the July ledger records this as never ruled; kept under PRO-15).

potential.year1_bands_basis: fitted anchors — retrodiction cohort year-one billings, n = 31 (PROSPECT_PHASE0 §14.4, 2026-09-05): Q1 $5,898 · median $16,318 · Q3 $46,151; $100K is the Tier-1 partner threshold. The July prior table ($145K/$73K/$55K/$43K/$27K/$22K) is retired as biased high (§14.5 C1).

year1_icp_prior_band.basis: reasoned from cohort tier medians (Platinum $43,956 · Gold $20,374 · Silver $10,012 · Bronze $5,538, n = 31) and the ICP-definition ticket midpoints ($6K/$15K/$30K). Unfitted per ICP; labelled so.

rules.label: Medium
rules.when: headcount_label == inferred OR (headcount == null AND stated_ceiling != null)

confidence.basis: locked headroom method: High if headcount is evidence (LinkedIn, site, Clutch), Medium if inferred, Low if guessed

snapshot_at_signing.note: Phase 4. Frozen at first SOW, scored against Orbit and QuickBooks actuals; interval hit-rate, median error by estimator and ICP, Brier on the two binaries.

signals.ruling: Research §7 catalog; computed, not stamped by hand. Decay on behaviour only (MadKudu: weight * max(0, 1 - age_days / lifespan_days)). Fit never decays.
signals.decay_formula: weight_now = decays ? weight * max(0, 1 - age_days / lifespan_days) : (age_days <= lifespan_days ? weight : 0)

champion_job_change.label: Past champion or contact moved to a new agency

next_step_agreed.label: Next step agreed on a call

new_client_win.label: New client win or AOR announcement

cluster_hiring.label: Cluster hiring for developers or designers (3+ roles)

freelance_dev_posting.label: Freelance or Upwork dev posting by the agency

leadership_change.label: New COO, ops director or head of delivery

owner_capacity_post.label: Owner posts about capacity or hiring pain

peer_group_attendance.label: Attends AMI, BABA, Agency Builders; joins a peer group

prior_grade.label: Prior grade from an earlier list or model
prior_grade.note: Every letter grade from Gotham, the Tier 1 Book, the July wave, AMIN, Pittsburgh or the Cold Pool is kept as this signal with its source. It never scores.

manual_note.label: Peer-group or conference intel entered by hand

urgency.basis: reasoned — thresholds to be re-cut where the staircase breaks once outcomes exist

routing.rule: One strong signal (weight >= 8) or two medium signals (weight >= 4) inside a 30-day window creates a task with an SLA; a single medium signal is a note; weak signals only update the profile.

deal_health.ruling: Research §Read 4: rules, not a model. Gong-style warnings with thresholds from WLIQ's own stage medians once Pipedrive is readable; defaults below until then.

red_when_any.test: days since last buyer-initiated touch >= 21 AND no next meeting booked
red_when_any.message: 21+ days without a buyer touch and nothing scheduled
Close date pushed three times or once by more than three weeks
Stalled in stage at more than twice WLIQ's median
Two or more calls and no decision-maker has attended or replied

red_when_any.test: indecision_level == high OR (risk_words_present == true AND next_meeting_at == null)
red_when_any.message: High indecision language with no next step

yellow_when_any.test: days since last buyer-initiated touch between 14 and 20

yellow_when_any.message: Price not discussed by the second call
Fewer than two buyer contacts engaged

deal_health.stage_exit_criteria_note: Enforced both in Pipedrive required fields and here, because API writes bypass Pipedrive's checks (R6). Phase 3.

override.ruling: PRO-5 revision (2026-09-04): override authority sits with Brian alone. July (ruled): one grade max, written reason required.
override.beyond_cap: refused — the engine rejects an override more than one tier from the computed tier rather than applying it

raters.ruling: PRO-5: the two sales raters enter facts on their own rows; Brian may stand in, recorded AS a stand-in. Per-rater calibration is a first-class output; for a rater with few rows report an interval and say plainly when history is too thin.
raters.note: Under PRO-2r there are no judgment scales — raters enter FACTS with evidence. Attribution still matters: every fact carries entered_by, stand_in and observed_at.

status_rules.Parked: any gate with mode park has result fail
status_rules.Unclassified: icp_class is null after the classification flow
status_rules.Overridden: an override with reason_code and approver is set and within the cap

flags.note: A flag warns and never caps (Client Book principle carried over). Every flag is a displayed signal and an action cue.

reason_sentence.shape: Anticipated {tier} ({confidence}): {icp_class} {agency_type_words}, {qualification words}; ceiling {ceiling} on {headroom_band or 'unknown headroom'}, year one likely {year1_band}; {urgency} — {top signal or 'no live signal'}.
reason_sentence.rule: The page shows the sentence and the breakdown, never a bare number.

still_open: PRO-2r-a — broker character as a safety gate (gate mode is 'flag' until ruled).
How many Dimension A facts must be present before a prospect can be ranked (min_facts_to_publish_tier = 0 until ruled).
Is the ≥ $2K economic floor about the hourly rate or the deal size (floor_basis = deal_size until ruled).
Who performs the promotion confirmation under PRO-18 (owner lane until ruled).
The sizing pass mark on bands (PRO-16).

The five July elements the July ledger records as never ruled: gates as written, ICP → grade mapping, adjust rules as written, climb-evidence requirement, Grade × Ceiling output shape. All five are toggles here.
